body.title: Update the guarded entry-point inventory and prove the two-clone handoff end to end
body.summary: Add the park and resume entry points to src/workflow/__tests__/gate-guarded-entry-points.test.ts (resumeStage asks the author gate, parkDraft reads the holder through the gate) and add an end-to-end test with a bare origin and two clones at different absolute paths: refusal with an offer, park, resume at the right turn, and the lost-machine restart.
acceptanceChecks: Removing the gate call from resumeStage or parkDraft fails the inventory test
The end-to-end test goes from a reassignment refusal with an offer through park to resume on the second clone
The lost-machine case restarts only the stage that has no artifact

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/gate-guarded-entry-points.test.ts: the inventory of guarded entry points (daemon step phases, approveArtifactByJsonPath, approveWorkflowTarget, resolveReviewFinding apply) is complete, and the analyze and code-review steps are not on it

src/workflow/team/__tests__/handoff-e2e.test.ts: from a reassignment refusal with an offer through park to resume on a second clone, and after a lost machine with no parked branch only the stage that has no artifact restarts, a committed LLD leaving the plan to do
